relationships.subject: NR_030675
relationships.evidence_quote: Additionally, Apobec3b was upregulated by lncRNA (NR_030675), which was obtained by lncRNA target gene prediction in the spinal cord dorsal horn.

key_findings: Microarray of rat spinal dorsal horn 6 weeks after RTX: 745 mRNAs and 139 lncRNAs up, 590 mRNAs and 140 lncRNAs down.
RT-qPCR validated four lncRNAs and Apobec3b; NR_030675 and Apobec3b levels were associated.
